minimal.purpose: Compile the mandatory model, integrity, transaction and recovery code without optional features.

default.purpose: Check what an ordinary Cargo invocation enables.

all-stable.purpose: Compile all stable optional features for this target together. There are currently none.

proof-extraction.purpose: Compile the minimal workspace with the individual model extraction feature enabled.

experimental-linux-managed-sync.purpose: Check the opt-in held ext4 mount attribute adapter and its separately qualified native integration test.

experimental-linux-public-apply.purpose: Compile the explicit Linux read-only public-stage inspection command.

experimental-linux-managed-sync-preview.purpose: Check the default-off managed sync assembly and its exact native integration target without selecting CLI dispatch.

experimental-apfs-copy.purpose: Compile the opt-in transfer policies, native runtime, and managed APFS regressions.

experimental-windows-diff.purpose: Compile the opt-in local NTFS comparison CLI and the platform protected-snapshot reader.

experimental-windows-copy.purpose: Compile the optional private NTFS staging capability and Windows qualification fixtures.

experimental-windows-bootstrap-inspect.purpose: Compile the opt-in Windows CLI inspection of one independently selected authenticated bootstrap.

experimental-wireguard-protocol.purpose: Check the in-memory WireGuard packet adapter in a separate workspace profile on each CI target.

experimental-wireguard-udp.purpose: Check the connected WireGuard UDP actor and loopback fixtures in isolation.

experimental-wireguard-tcp.purpose: Check the bounded embedded TCP stack and caller-supervised stream without the native UDP actor.

experimental-wireguard-tcp-udp.purpose: Check the opt-in connected WireGuard UDP actor and embedded TCP flow together.

experimental-ssh.purpose: Compile the opt-in read-only SSH/SFTP adapter for dependency review and synthetic in-process tests.

experimental-sftp.purpose: Check the held SFTP source adapter and its selected transport without selecting an application workflow.

experimental-ssh-capture.purpose: Check opt-in direct Linux SSH/SFTP get and remote-resume with independent destination qualification, and portable private capture from a held SFTP source.

experimental-verified-prefix-resume.purpose: Compile the default-off first witnessed verified-prefix resume path with independently selected qualifications and current explicit retention authorization.

experimental-ssh-wireguard.purpose: Check Linux application composition of pinned SSH/SFTP through one owned embedded WireGuard TCP flow.

development-all.purpose: Compile all features applicable to the target together with the default workspace.

experimental-ssh.purpose: Enable the caller-routed, pinned-host, read-only SSH/SFTP library without enabling a product workflow.

experimental-sftp.purpose: Enable the held SFTP source capability over the exact experimental SSH transport.

experimental-linux-public-apply.purpose: Expose read-only public-stage inspection under an independently selected public owner key.

experimental-linux-managed-sync.purpose: Compose the exact owner-private managed sync policy, held Linux read lease and authenticated historical preview.

experimental-ssh-capture.purpose: Expose held SFTP private capture and the opt-in direct Linux command with a scoped Tokio runtime.

experimental-verified-prefix-resume.purpose: Select the default-off first witnessed resume front door; native production qualification remains separate.

experimental-ssh-wireguard.purpose: Select the owned embedded WireGuard SSH carrier for Linux get and remote-resume with independent destination qualification.

experimental-windows-diff.purpose: Build the opt-in local NTFS read-only CLI comparison.

experimental-windows-bootstrap-inspect.purpose: Expose read-only first-frame bootstrap inspection through the Windows CLI.

windows-bootstrap-fixture.purpose: Compile the opt-in native Windows first-segment inspection fixture without selecting product dispatch.

experimental-apfs-copy.purpose: Compose the experimental managed APFS copy and recovery entry points with the mounted adapter.

experimental-protocol.purpose: Enable only the exact BoringTun protocol backend for the default-off in-memory packet adapter.

experimental-udp.purpose: Enable bounded I/O through an approved connected UDP socket.

experimental-tcp.purpose: Enable one bounded embedded TCP flow with supervised I/O and cancellation.

proof-extraction.purpose: Expose annotations for the pinned hax extraction path.

experimental-linux-managed-sync.purpose: Observe exact native ext4 mount attributes for the experimental managed sync profile.

experimental-windows-copy.purpose: Expose held-directory Windows private stage creation, bounded writes, confirmed file flush and close, and independent read-back.

experimental-windows-read.purpose: Admit held regular files and protected snapshots under the separate Windows read-only platform profiles.

windows-read-fixture.purpose: Compile private held-directory and exact comparison fixtures. The fixture uses its own test dependencies.

experimental-apfs-copy.purpose: Enable the managed APFS operation policies, canonical records, and recovery decisions.

hmac.purpose: Match OpenSSH v1 hashed host labels through bounded HMAC-SHA1; never an SSH authentication algorithm.

sha1.purpose: Supply only the digest in OpenSSH hashed-host label compatibility; host-key fingerprints remain SHA256.

apfs-mounted.purpose: Perform descriptor-scoped mounted APFS operations under the macOS adapter contract.

base64.purpose: Encode the bounded raw-byte fields of public integrity manifests.

base64ct.purpose: Decode fixed-size protected WireGuard key Base64 into caller-owned zeroizing storage.

bytes.purpose: Pass bounded SFTP frames to the upstream packet codec and hold its encoded responses.

russh.purpose: Perform SSH key exchange, authenticate one pinned peer on a caller-owned stream, and request its SFTP subsystem.

russh-sftp.purpose: Encode and decode admitted SFTP v3 requests and preserve raw file and handle bytes.

tokio.purpose: Supply bounded async I/O and timers for caller-owned SSH streams and selectable WireGuard UDP and TCP adapters.

tokio-util.purpose: Fence owned SSH or embedded TCP streams when an operation fails or its owner is dropped.

smoltcp.purpose: Supply the fixed-pair userspace IPv4 and IPv6 TCP stack with explicit Reno congestion control.

boringtun.purpose: Supply WireGuard handshake and authenticated packet operations for the isolated experimental adapter.

blake3.purpose: Source stream and independent stage read-back digests, and content bindings.

clap.purpose: Parse the native CLI argument grammar and generate command help and usage.

crc32c.purpose: Detect torn or corrupt journal frames before authenticated record decoding.

ed25519-dalek.purpose: Sign and verify transaction records and verify historical workflow closure.

getrandom.purpose: Obtain the fixed-width stage-attempt entropy prefix from the macOS system random source.

hax-lib.purpose: Annotate the model for proof extraction.

libc.purpose: Access platform functions and constants unavailable through the safe wrapper, including the opt-in Linux statmount query.

minicbor.purpose: Read and write bounded, explicitly encoded journal records and receipts.

nix.purpose: Read fallible uname identification in the Linux destination qualification adapter.

rustix.purpose: Perform capability-scoped filesystem operations and obtain required OS process and entropy data.

serde.purpose: Describe stable field and enum names for CLI reports.

jiff.purpose: Validate Plan civil dates and normalize timestamps without clock or timezone data.

serde_json.purpose: Serialize the versioned CLI report on all command targets.

uuid.purpose: Represent and encode fixed-size transaction identities.

windows-sys.purpose: Provide Windows ABI bindings for experimental private NTFS staging, held reads and protected-snapshot token checks.

zeroize.purpose: Clear owned copies of signing key material and SSH password input.

cli.copy_and_recovery: Linux verified single-file transfer and recovery
cli.manifest_and_verification: Unsigned single-file baseline creation and read-only content verification

cli.diff: regular files in managed APFS directories with --managed-macos

other_targets: No CI build or release qualification is asserted for other triples.
